Maya: heads up — customer reported seeing other orgs' model names in their usage dashboard. https://console/redwood/usage?id=org-A
Samir: holy — repro steps?
Maya: open console as org-A -> Billing > Usage -> filter last 30d. some rows show models owned by org-B, token counts that don't match org-A activity
Liam: is this the old cache key collision (userId vs workspaceId)?
Priya: initial glance: telemetry pipeline sometimes attaches `tenant` from async worker context, not request session. we might be dropping/overwriting `tenant_id` in queue payloads
Maya: logs attached:
```
2025-11-02T14:07:12.345Z INFO req=rq_9a org=org-A event=usage_emit tenant=org-B payload_id=px_42
```
Samir: that line is the smoking gun — request shows org-A but tenant=org-B in emitted event
Priya: repro: open org-A dashboard, quickly switch orgs in console autocomplete, export usage. race between session update and in-flight telemetry aggregation
Liam: root cause seems to be ambient context propagation into long-running aggregator tasks. aggregator pulls `context.tenant` from a global store when job runs, which can contain last-active org for the process
Maya: suggested quick mitigation: disable aggregator cache for console export routes and add server-side guard to drop telemetry where `event.tenant != session.org`
Samir: agree — also add a middleware that asserts `x-tenant` header present on internal RPCs. makes the contract explicit instead of implicit context magic
Priya: there's an internal API debate here — many services prefer ambient ctx to reduce call-site noise. but for anything that crosses async boundaries we should require explicit tenant param
Liam: proposed rollout plan:
- hotfix: console rejects mismatched telemetry + disable aggregator cache (hotpatch)
- short term: add assertion middleware + additional logs (48h)
- medium: change aggregator RPC signature to include explicit `tenant_id` and update callers (1 week)
- long term: audit caches and add lint rule for RPCs that cross goroutines to require explicit tenant (postmortem)
Maya: I'll push the hotfix now. prepping PR and runbook.
deploy-bot: starting deploy: console/telemetry-guard v2025.11.02 -> staging (sha: d4f2a1)
monitoring-bot: incident filed: INC-2345 CUSTOMER_DATA_POTENTIAL_LEAK — severity P2. linked: https://ops/inc/2345
Samir: I'll own the API PR. will add an internal RFC to settle ambient vs explicit tenant rules
Priya: I'll draft suggested customer note and coordinate CS if anyone reaches out. also adding unit + e2e repro for session-switch race
Liam: tests: add e2e that switches orgs mid-export + assert no cross-tenant rows. I'll pair on that with Samir
Maya: thanks folks. follow-up in #eng-platform in ~30m with deploy outcome :thumbsup:
